context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about succession planning
purpose: Teach: 出展/移譲/監修/補欠/採点/燃焼/立証/責務

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 後継者を育てるというのは、経営者の最も重い責務だと私は思っているよ。
lines.en: Raising a successor is, in my view, the heaviest duty an executive bears.
lines.style: Measured elder tone, reflective and weighty advisory register

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そうですね。来月の展示会にも、若手に作品を出展させてみようかと考えています。
lines.en: You're right. I'm thinking of having the younger staff exhibit work at next month's trade show too.
lines.style: Respectful younger executive, thoughtful and slightly deferential

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いいね。ただ、評価する時に採点基準を曖昧にすると、本人たちが混乱するから注意しなさい。
lines.en: Good. But if you leave the scoring criteria vague when evaluating them, they'll get confused, so be careful.
lines.style: Firm mentorship, practical guidance with paternal warmth

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。実は権限移譲のタイミングについても、ずっと悩んでいまして。
lines.en: I see. Honestly, I've been agonizing over the timing of delegating authority as well.
lines.style: Earnest confession, vulnerable and seeking wisdom

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 全てを一気に渡すのではなく、最初はベテランの監修のもとで小さな案件から任せるのが安全だ。
lines.en: Rather than handing everything over at once, it's safer to start with small projects under a veteran's supervision.
lines.style: Sage advisory tone, slow and deliberate teaching cadence

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: では、本人に能力があると立証できた段階で、徐々に範囲を広げていけばいいわけですね。
lines.en: So once they've proven their capability, I should gradually expand the scope of their responsibilities.
lines.style: Clarifying reformulation, attentive student-like engagement, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: その通り。それと、補欠的な扱いではなく、本気で次世代として育てる覚悟が必要だよ。
lines.en: Exactly. And you need the resolve to raise them as the true next generation, not treat them as backups.
lines.style: Conviction-laden, emphatic but composed elder counsel

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 肝に銘じます。自分の代で完全燃焼するつもりで、後進を全力で支えていきます。
lines.en: I'll take that to heart. I'll fully spend myself in my own tenure and support the next generation with everything I have.
lines.style: Determined commitment, formal pledge with quiet passion
